notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Ticktock is updated to version v1.1

[h1]What's New[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added progress bar for stages (can be disabled in options)
[*]Added popup text when dash is recharging
[*]Added new effects when player is hit
[*]Added new tutorial text in Denial (destroy all enemies to advance)
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reworked Covenant's sound effects
[*]Changed player's font appearance
[*]Rebalanced levels Denial, Anger, Anger Nightmare, Acceptance (easier)
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[*]Fixed sprite ordering

notes.title: Ticktock: Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32918832/0981e6cadf7d8f400f9c11f8df6ec5e439a077bd.gif[/img]

Three years of learning game development later, Ticktock is the first of my games to be released on Steam. It has been an exciting experience working on this game, and I hope you will feel the same when playing :)

Have fun!

notes.title: Ticktock: Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hey!

Ticktock has been in development for four months, made with love, passion, and dedication. As a fan of many indie games, I'd dream I would one day be able to create something as amazing as most classic indie titles, something which people can enjoy and have fun with.

I hope that, when Ticktock is finally released, that people from around the world can enjoy the work I've created.

I'll be looking forward to it :)

~ Petraller
